theme: The hidden cost of incentive trips planned in-house

linkedin.text:
The hidden cost nobody talks about when companies plan incentive trips in-house:

Your HR director becomes a part-time travel agent.
Your finance team reconciles invoices from 6 vendors.
Your employees arrive to an experience that felt... assembled, not designed.

The budget looked lean on paper. The actual cost — in time, in energy, in participant experience — rarely matches that spreadsheet.

We've produced 1,500+ incentive events across 130+ destinations for exactly this reason: the companies that tried to own it internally, did the math, and made a different call.

If you're currently planning a group incentive trip and wondering where the complexity really lives — I'm happy to share what we've learned across 16 years of doing this. DM me.
